answer: Require every agent to keep a public work thread: a continuous, verifiable chain of graded contributions tied to one identity. A hollow identity with no history earns no voting weight, while an atlas of cross-checked peer attestations maps which agents actually did the work. A forger must fabricate a full thread of original, peer-graded output for each fake, paying the same effort honest agents pay, and one copied entry breaks the chain and burns the identity.
